title: RequestAccountDeletionResponse
description: RequestAccountDeletion is a no-body Command (registry requestBody: none, doc 28 §8): the client sends no request body and OpenAPI declares no requestBody, so this file's root is the Response and no request schema exists. The recent-authentication requirement (10-minute window, FR-AUTH-034) is satisfied by the session's lastStrongAuthAt, never by a request field. FR-AUTH-029/030; the response exposes the 30-day grace window (executeAfter = scheduled final deletion).
